name: Volvo Penta
founded_note: Volvo Penta traces its origin to Skofde Gjuteri och Mekaniska Verkstad (1868); first engine (B1) built in 1907; AB Volvo Penta is an independent company within the Volvo Group
employees_note: Not published on volvopenta.com; Volvo Group does not break out Volvo Penta headcount on the pages fetched
revenue_note: Not published separately on volvopenta.com pages fetched
sector: Genset engines 150 to 833 kVA (D8, D13, D16, D17 diesel and G17 natural gas), BESS subsystems for OEMs, marine and industrial engines
positioning_text: Volvo Penta sells engines, not gensets, so it competes with Cummins Arabia through independent Gulf packagers that pick a Volvo D13, D16 or D17 for the 400 to 833 kVA band. Its message is automotive-scale production, short lead times, HVO100 compatibility on every engine built since 2016, and a modular data centre approach; it does not have an engine above about 880 kVA, so it is absent from the large data centre and utility band. The 2023 D17 (TWD1744GE, 758 kVA prime at 50 Hz) and the 2026 G17 natural gas engine are its current power generation pushes. In Saudi Arabia, Almajd Power lists Volvo among the engines it packages; no other Gulf packager or Volvo Penta dealer for KSA, UAE or Kuwait could be verified from official sources.

movements.headline: Volvo Penta launches D17, its most powerful genset engine (TWD1744GE, 758 kVA prime at 50 Hz) (baseline)
movements.summary: 17.26 litre six cylinder with dual-stage turbochargers and common rail, EPA Tier 2 certified for stationary emergency, dual speed 1500/1800 rpm, service interval up to 1,000 hours; 50 Hz prime 758 kVA, standby 833 kVA; 60 Hz prime 801 kVA, standby 881 kVA.

relevance.analysis: Lifts Volvo's ceiling to about 880 kVA standby at 60 Hz, which puts Volvo-powered packager sets against Cummins QSX15 and QSK23 based sets in Saudi commercial and industrial standby. Above that band Volvo has no offer.

movements.headline: Volvo Penta positions itself as total power solutions provider for the digital infrastructure market at CONEXPO 2026
movements.summary: Volvo Penta announced it would show D8 Stage V/Tier 4 Final, BESS, electric driveline and its energy transition roadmap, and referenced BESS wins with KJ Power (Turkey), Aura Clean Energy and SEETEL.

relevance.analysis: KJ Power is a Turkish packager active in Gulf tenders; Volvo BESS subsystems inside packager products would compete with Cummins BESS in rental and hybrid applications.

movements.headline: Volvo Penta introduces G17 natural gas engine for power generation, aimed at data centres and utilities
movements.summary: First Volvo Penta natural gas genset engine, framed as lower-emission, scalable backup power for data centres, utilities and mission-critical infrastructure.

relevance.analysis: Adds a gas option at the 17 litre node for packagers. In the Gulf the relevant overlap is with Cummins gas gensets in the 400 to 700 kW band for oil and gas and utility sites in KSA and Kuwait.

movements.headline: Volvo Penta reports doubled industrial engine sales in North America and targets the data centre boom
movements.summary: Volvo Penta said North American industrial engine sales doubled and highlighted backup power and BESS solutions for data centres ahead of CONEXPO 2026.

relevance.analysis: Growth is US-led. No Gulf-specific volume signal found.

movements.headline: Volvo Penta publishes data centre backup power positioning: Tier 4 Final platform, modular approach, independent partner to OEMs and system integrators
movements.summary: Volvo Penta states it collaborates with OEMs and system integrators on flexible data centre backup power, cites automotive-scale production for shorter lead times, stackable modular configurations and HVO100 compatibility for all engines built since 2016.

relevance.analysis: Volvo's data centre pitch is modular many-small-units, which fits edge and enterprise sites rather than the hyperscale campuses driving Gulf demand. Cummins Arabia should watch packager bids on edge data centres in UAE.

movements.headline: Volvo Penta adds D13 power node TAD1346GE 500 kVA
movements.summary: New D13 rating described as reliable, compact and fuel-efficient addition to the power offer.

relevance.analysis: 500 kVA is the most contested packager node in the Gulf commercial market; a D13 at 500 kVA competes with Cummins QSX15 based sets on price through packagers.
